verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is fundamentally a headless, API/SDK/CLI-driven cloud browser service — sessions run in the cloud with no local browser needed, exposing WebSocket/CDP endpoints for Playwright/Puppeteer plus official SDKs and a CLI (`hx`), which is exactly the shape needed for CI/automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions docs) and independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage.
